message.rule: a wish stays inside the arena and its prep room
message.why: the arena is where the battles happen, and the prep room is where you get ready

_notes: What Moddy Arena allows. arena_place (the arena's own rule type): the fighting floor's width inside its walls, the prep room's width, and the arena wall's height, in blocks; odd widths, arena 15 to 63, prep room 5 to 15 and smaller than the arena, wall 3 to 8. They are read when the place is first built and kept with it after that. arena_waves (the arena's own rule type): a battle's waves, in order, each a list of {mob, count} spawned at once on the arena floor (1 to 100 waves; a count 1 to 20; at most 40 mobs a wave); countdownSeconds before the first wave (3 to 60), breatherSeconds, the break after a wave (3 to 120), and bossBreatherSeconds, the longer break after a boss wave (3 to 300; without it, 30 or breatherSeconds if longer), in which the gate is open and the fighters may change their hotbars in the prep room (while a wave is on the gate is iron bars and every fighter is taken into the arena) and press READY on the board to end it sooner; the arena mends itself in each break, waveSeconds a wave may last before the battle is lost (30 to 1800). First values are guesses, to be tuned by playing. Any living mob id is accepted except those that cannot stay in the arena (fliers, climbers, teleporters, creepers, silverfish; the file is refused, saying why). These are the base waves: the difficulty the player picks on the battle arena control panel in the prep room (easy, normal, hard, extreme; normal is these waves exactly) scales every count by its wave size (easy 3, normal 5, hard 6, extreme 8, out of 10; 5 is these waves exactly), swaps mob kinds and sets their health, and its waves (5, 10, 15, 20 or endless; 5 by default) say how many waves a battle has: past these, waves are made from the wave's number by the generator (optional key generator: addPerWave 0 to 5, healthPerWave 0 to 0.5, maxHealth 1 to 5, kinds [{mob, from, weight}]). Every bossEvery-th wave (optional, 0 or 2 to 50, default 5) is a boss wave: a named boss and a small escort. Each player has lives lives in a battle (optional, 1 to 10, default 3). Optional keys: waveSizes ({easy: 2, hard: 7}: a difficulty's own wave size, 1 to 10), waveSize (1 to 10: every difficulty's wave size) or maxWaveSize (the biggest any brings), and to fix or limit the panel's choices difficulty or maxDifficulty, waveCount (a multiple of 5 up to 995, or "endless") or maxWaveCount (a multiple of 5) (a key or its max, not both; nor waveSize and waveSizes); without them the player chooses. A change applies to the next battle. arena_wishes (the arena's own rule type): magicianWishes, how many Magician wishes each player may make between two battles (0 to 20; counted when the Magician starts one, given back when it fails, is stopped or is undone; Builder and Apprentice wishes are always free), cooldownSeconds, how long a kept thing rests after it is fired from the hotbar in a battle (1 to 120), and wishesPerWave, how many hotbar wishes each player may fire in one wave (1 to 50; every fire costs one, and the count starts again when a wave is cleared). In a battle only kept things fired again (the hotbar, Make another one) work. First values are guesses. arena_creatures (the arena's own rule type, every key optional): during a wave every creature a player wished into the arena takes one battle role, chosen from what the game says about it: a Fighter (its own attack at least fighterAttack, 0.5 to 50, or a monster) goes for the wave's monsters; a Tank (most health at least tankHealth, 10 to 1000, or at least tankWidth blocks wide, 0.5 to 5) draws the monsters within tauntRadius blocks (3 to 16) and has Resistance level tankResistance (0 to 3) while it holds them; any other creature that walks is a Healer, healing each fighter within healRadius blocks (2 to 16) by healAmount (0.5 to 4) at most every healSeconds (2 to 20), all his healers together, never more than 1 health a second; one that cannot walk is a Tank where it stands. A role stops at the wave's end and outside the arena. arena_ladder (the arena's own rule type): the wish ladder, limits that rise as a battle goes on. Every battle starts at the first step, the same for every fighter, and what it reached is gone when it ends; in prep the first step holds. progress says what a step counts in the battle: waves (waves cleared, the default) or bosses (bosses beaten). Each step is after N of them (the first after 0, each after more than the one before, at most 1000, at most 20 steps): the most a make may have, in the core's measured facts (healthHalfHearts and attackDamageHalfHearts in health points, two to a heart; scaleTimes; builderSizeStep 1 to 4; builderStrengthStep 1 to 3; countMade; amountItems; radiusBlocks; durationTicks, 20 a second; movementSpeedAttribute; extentBlocks); a fact a step does not name has no limit there, an unknown fact refuses the file, and a limit never falls from one step to the next. The core makes a bigger wish fit (smaller, fewer, gentler) and says so; it is never refused for being too strong. locked names kinds (creature, ride, item, machine, magic_block, building, picture, event, rule, supplies, other) and tags (fights, hostile, boss, changes_blocks, builds, summons, gives_items, world_rule, decorative, harmless) that are locked until a step opens them (opens: {kinds, tags}); every lock must be opened by some step. A step reached is told to everyone in the battle at the start of the break. Without this rule the default ladder holds. First values are guesses, to be tuned by playing. base_reach: a wish lands only inside the arena and its prep room (from the prep room: the prep room, or the arena straight ahead through the gate; from anywhere else: the arena), never outside the place and never in the Nether or the End. The clamp: a power at most 60 s and never forever, one stack of each item and 2 kinds a wish, 2 XP levels a wish; shortened or shrunk and said, never refused. Schema: the core's WorldRules.parse.
